data.gender_notes: Muruganantham is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muruganantham is derived from the name Murugan, a Tamil god. The name Murugan means 'Lord of the Mountains'. Anantham means 'endless' or 'eternal'. Thus, Muruganantham can be interpreted as 'Lord Murugan's endless grace'. The name Muruganantham carries the meaning “Lord Murugan's grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Tamil god Murugan tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Muruganantham usually hope their child will grow to embody lord murugan's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
